title: Owner Auto Policy Filed Driver Rating Plan — Age Class of a Driver Whose Exclusion Is Lifted
content:
**Age-class relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, an age-class relativity multiplies the lift share of a driver whose named driver exclusion is lifted on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent.

The driver's age is taken in whole years on the rating date, which is the processing date of the lift.
- The date of birth is the one on the driver's exclusion entry (the most recent driver-excluded entry on the term).
- A year is complete on the birthday.
- A 29 February birthday completes on 1 March in a year with no 29 February.

| Age on the processing date | Relativity |
|---|---|
| under 21 | 1.85 |
| at least 21 and under 25 | 1.35 |
| 25 or older | 1 |
| no such entry on the term | 1 |

**Sides of each line (hypothetical processing date of 3 April).**
- Born 4 April, 25 years earlier: 24, so 1.35.
- Born 3 April, 25 years earlier: 25, so 1.
- Born 3 April, 21 years earlier: 21, so 1.35.
- Born 4 April, 21 years earlier: 20, so 1.85.
